title: An agent can report its sub-agents to decade
body:
An agent reports to decade with `agent` messages on the socket (`AgentUpdate` in `decade-channel/src/lib.rs`, the `Agents` section of `docs/protocol.md`). The report carries one state for the whole agent (attention, done, working or idle), an activity line, a question, the model, context, tokens and cost. Nothing in it describes sub-agents or background tasks the agent has started. When the agent's turn ends while sub-agents still run, the agent reports `done`, and the workspace card turns green while work is still going on.

The fix for the wrong state belongs in coax first: it should keep reporting `working` while background work runs. This issue is the protocol side, so decade can show that work.

## Proposal

- `AgentUpdate` gains `subagents`: the list of sub-agents and background tasks the agent is running, each with a name, a one-line activity and a state (working, done or failed). An agent sends the whole list each time it changes. An empty list or an absent field means none.
- The workspace card's state line shows the count, such as `coax working · 2 sub-agents`, and the hover popover lists each sub-agent with its activity.
- A workspace whose agent reports `done` while a sub-agent still works sorts and colours as `working`.
- The `agents` MCP reply includes each agent's sub-agents.

## Cost

`AgentUpdate` is public in `decade-channel`, so the field moves its minor version. The protocol change moves `decade`'s minor. coax needs to send the list.

## Open

- Whether a finished or failed sub-agent stays in the list until the agent's next turn, or leaves as soon as it ends.
- Whether nested sub-agents are reported, or only the agent's direct ones.
- Whether a failed sub-agent should raise the workspace to `attention`.
